summary: Northann Corp. filed an 8-K on October 7, 2026, disclosing that on October 5, 2026 the Board elected Vincent La Scala as a director to fill the vacancy created by Umesh Patel's resignation. La Scala, a 30-year Citigroup credit-risk veteran through April 2023, becomes Audit Committee Chair and a member of the Nomination and Compensation Committees; the Board determined he is independent, financially literate and an audit committee financial expert. Separately, Item 8.01 disclosed other events. No terms, advisor or board recommendation were stated. Watch for follow-on 8.01 disclosures and any further board turnover.
